summary: Solo events that can become shared ones. Scope is per event, never per app.
invariants: every event starts MINE — being paired is not consent to publish your diary, and there is no share-everything switch
share() produces PROPOSED, never shared. Only the OTHER side's accept() makes it shared: putting something in someone else's calendar is scheduling them, not planning together.
you cannot accept your own proposal
declining is an answer, and the event stays in the proposer's own week rather than vanishing
§1.2 sharing with no shared calendar is REFUSED loudly — queuing into a calendar that does not exist would look like it worked and reach nobody
a remote proposal is stored as THEIRS; authorship is never trusted from the wire
SOLO IS NOT A LESSER MODE — add, list and keep all work with no partner anywhere
